final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor added no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrowing is directionally more accurate than an unconditional compliance claim, but it still does not satisfy the policy predicate that matters here: certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The available evidence shows aggregate readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, but it also shows a live subgroup regression, stale prior approval, and only an informal monitoring comment with no reviewed mitigation or disclosure attachment. That means the case is not "compliant_with_caveats" on the present record; that status would require evidence that the caveat has actually been carried into current documentation or covered by approved mitigation. Here, the caveat is still an unresolved compliance condition, so the support for certification remains incomplete and the correct final verdict is suspicious.
